| base report decode encode |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
#('cpp' 'swift') collect: [ :port | | input descs ids objects objectIds exportedNodes exportedObjects output seenCollections |
 input := NeoJSONReader fromString: ('/private/tmp/magritte-' , port , '-relations-native.json') asFileReference contents.
 descs := Dictionary new. ids := IdentityDictionary new. objects := Dictionary new. objectIds := IdentityDictionary new.
 (input at: 'descriptions') do: [ :n | | cls d |
 cls := n at: 'class'.
 (#('MAContainer' 'MAPriorityContainer' 'MAStringDescription' 'MANumberDescription' 'MABooleanDescription' 'MAToOneRelationDescription' 'MAToManyRelationDescription' 'MAToManyScalarRelationDescription' 'MASingleOptionDescription' 'MAMultipleOptionDescription') includes: cls) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported reference class' ].
 d := (Smalltalk globals at: cls asSymbol) new.
 descs at: (n at: 'id') put: d. ids at: d put: (n at: 'id') ].
 (input at: 'objects') do: [ :o | | m | m := MAAdaptiveModel description: (descs at: (o at: 'description')).
 objects at: (o at: 'id') put: m. objectIds at: m put: (o at: 'id') ].
 decode := [ :j | | type values |
 type := j at: 'type'.
 type = 'nil' ifTrue: [ nil ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'reference' ifTrue: [ objects at: (j at: 'value') ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'integer' ifTrue: [ Integer readFrom: (j at: 'value') readStream ] ifFalse: [
 (#('string' 'boolean') includes: type) ifTrue: [ j at: 'value' ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'character' ifTrue: [ (j at: 'value') first ] ifFalse: [
 values := (j at: 'value') collect: [ :e | decode value: e ].
 type = 'array' ifTrue: [ values asArray ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'ordered' ifTrue: [ values asOrderedCollection ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'set' ifTrue: [ values asSet ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'bag' ifTrue: [ values asBag ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported value kind' ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
 (input at: 'descriptions') do: [ :n | | d |
 d := descs at: (n at: 'id').
 (n at: 'properties') keysAndValuesDo: [ :k :v | d propertyAt: k asSymbol put: (decode value: v) ].
 d isContainer ifTrue: [ (n at: 'children') do: [ :id | d add: (descs at: id) ] ] ifFalse: [
 d accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: ((n at: 'accessor') at: 'key')) ].
 (d isKindOf: MAReferenceDescription) ifTrue: [ d reference: (descs at: (n at: 'reference')) ].
 (d isKindOf: MARelationDescription) ifTrue: [
 d classes: ((n at: 'classes') collect: [ :cls |
 (#('Object' 'MABasicObject' 'MAAdaptiveModel' 'UndefinedObject' 'String' 'Boolean' 'Number' 'Integer' 'Character' 'Collection' 'SequenceableCollection' 'Array' 'OrderedCollection' 'Set' 'Bag') includes: cls) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported class constraint' ].
 Smalltalk globals at: cls asSymbol ]) ].
 (d isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [ | labels |
 d options: ((n at: 'options') collect: [ :v | decode value: v ]).
 labels := IdentityDictionary new.
 (n at: 'labels') do: [ :entry | labels at: (decode value: (entry at: 'value')) put: (entry at: 'label') ].
 labels isEmpty ifFalse: [ d propertyAt: #labels put: labels ] ] ].
 (input at: 'objects') do: [ :o | | m | m := objects at: (o at: 'id').
 (o at: 'values') keysAndValuesDo: [ :id :v | m write: (decode value: v) using: (descs at: id) ].
 (m magritteDescription isSatisfiedBy: m) ifFalse: [ self error: 'GT rejected native-edited relational object' ] ].
 (((objects at: 'ada') readUsing: (descs at: 'spouse')) == (objects at: 'bob')) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Alias lost' ].
 (((objects at: 'bob') readUsing: (descs at: 'spouse')) == (objects at: 'ada')) ifFalse: [ self error: 'Cycle lost' ].
 seenCollections := IdentitySet new.
 encode := [ :v | | type |
 (objectIds includesKey: v) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'reference'. 'value' -> (objectIds at: v) } ] ifFalse: [
 v isNil ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'nil' } ] ifFalse: [
 (v isKindOf: Boolean) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'boolean'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [
 v isInteger ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'integer'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 v isString ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'string'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [
 v isCharacter ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'character'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 (seenCollections includes: v) ifTrue: [ self error: 'Aliased/cyclic value collections are not portable in graph/2' ].
 seenCollections add: v.
 type := v class = Array ifTrue: [ 'array' ] ifFalse: [
 (v isKindOf: OrderedCollection) ifTrue: [ 'ordered' ] ifFalse: [
 (v isKindOf: Set) ifTrue: [ 'set' ] ifFalse: [
 (v isKindOf: Bag) ifTrue: [ 'bag' ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported reference value' ] ] ] ].
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> type. 'value' -> (v collect: [ :e | encode value: e ]) asArray } ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
 exportedNodes := (input at: 'descriptions') collect: [ :n | | d props e labels |
 d := descs at: (n at: 'id'). props := Dictionary new.
 d properties keysAndValuesDo: [ :k :v |
 k = #labels ifFalse: [
 k = #displayBlockOrSymbol ifTrue: [ v = #greaseString ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported display override' ] ]
 ifFalse: [ props at: k asString put: (encode value: v) ] ] ].
 e := Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> (n at: 'id'). 'class' -> d class name asString. 'properties' -> props }.
 d isContainer ifTrue: [ e at: 'children' put: (d children collect: [ :child | ids at: child ]) asArray ]
 ifFalse: [ e at: 'accessor' put: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> 'MADictionaryAccessor'. 'key' -> d accessor key }) ].
 (d isKindOf: MAReferenceDescription) ifTrue: [ e at: 'reference' put: (ids at: d reference) ].
 (d isKindOf: MARelationDescription) ifTrue: [ e at: 'classes' put: (d classes collect: [ :cls | cls name asString ]) asArray ].
 (d isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [
 e at: 'options' put: (d options collect: [ :v | encode value: v ]) asArray.
 labels := OrderedCollection new.
 (d propertyAt: #labels ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ]) keysAndValuesDo: [ :v :label | labels add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'value' -> (encode value: v). 'label' -> label }) ].
 e at: 'labels' put: labels asArray ].
 e ].
 exportedObjects := (input at: 'objects') collect: [ :o | | m values |
 m := objects at: (o at: 'id'). values := Dictionary new.
 m values keysAndValuesDo: [ :d :v | values at: (ids at: d) put: (encode value: v) ].
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> (o at: 'id'). 'description' -> (ids at: m magritteDescription). 'values' -> values } ].
 output := Dictionary newFrom: { 'format' -> 'magritte.graph/2'. 'root' -> (input at: 'root'). 'descriptions' -> exportedNodes. 'objects' -> exportedObjects }.
 ('/private/tmp/magritte-' , port , '-relations-gt.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate. s nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: output) ].
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'port' -> port. 'valid' -> true. 'cyclePreserved' -> true. 'descriptions' -> descs size. 'objects' -> objects size } ]
] ] ensure: [
 (base , 'relations-roundtrip-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate. s nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"kind":"pure-magritte-reference","nativeResources":false}' ] ].
